title: Inventory upstream capabilities and verified Rust port coverage
summary: For each in-scope upstream C capability in an authorized C-to-Rust port, record its Rust implementation or replacement mapping, track implementation and verification status, and explicitly identify missing, incompatible or unverified behavior.
statement: For each in-scope upstream C capability in an authorized C-to-Rust port, record its Rust implementation or replacement mapping, track implementation and verification status, and explicitly identify missing, incompatible or unverified behavior.
rationale: A source-to-target coverage inventory makes omissions and fidelity gaps visible; code quantity or successful compilation alone is not evidence that the agreed baseline has been replaced.

conditions: An upstream baseline and the port's in-scope feature set have been identified.
exceptions: Out-of-scope features and accepted deviations remain explicitly recorded and are not silently reported as implemented.

bounds.window: each in-scope port verification or implementation cycle
